meta.freeride.title: Freeride & Cat Skiing in Ridder, Kazakhstan — Snowcat and Snowmobile Drop-offs | Asferia
meta.freeride.desc: Freeride near Ridder in the Western Altai, East Kazakhstan: cat skiing (5–8 runs a day, groups up to 12) and snowmobile drop-offs (8–10 runs a day, up to 6). Season mid-November to mid-April. Airport pick-up in Ust-Kamenogorsk, accommodation and week-long packages arranged.

winter.freeride_cta.p: Cat skiing and snowmobile drop-offs into untracked snow. One day, or a full week with accommodation and transfers.

hero.sub: Snowcat trips, snowmobiles and freeride near Ridder. We drive up to passes that in summer you reach on foot, and ride untracked powder. We meet you in Ust-Kamenogorsk, book your stay and drive you — everything is on us, as in summer.

block.sub: Snowcat and snowmobile trips are for everyone — no skiing involved. Freeride is for skiers and snowboarders.

items: Where is the freeride?
Near Ridder, on the ridges of the Western Altai in East Kazakhstan. Ridder is 120 km from Ust-Kamenogorsk.
How do I get to Ridder?
Fly to Ust-Kamenogorsk (Oskemen, UKK) via Almaty or Astana. Ridder is about two hours by road; we pick you up at the airport.
When is the season?
From mid-November to mid-April, snow permitting.
What level do I need?
You should ski or ride confidently. The guide picks slopes for the group — from first days off-piste to steeper terrain.
Can I rent equipment?
Avalanche gear and radios can be rented on site. Bring your own skis or snowboard.
Can you arrange accommodation and transfers?
Yes. We meet you at Ust-Kamenogorsk airport, book your stay in Ridder and drive you to the start every day.
